translations.web: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
translations.bsb: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
translations.kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
translations.asv: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.
